Hello Khizar,

As per your request, please find below the 1-month rate for Elite Business Bay Residences:

*
View Apartment Details
*

September : AED 6,500 ( 30 nights )
Security Deposit: AED 2,000 (refundable)

Please note that the booking will be processed on a monthly basis, with each month calculated as 30 nights.

Link: https://www.bayut.com/property/details-9186164.html

*
Before proceeding with the booking, we kindly recommend that you view the apartment first. If you are satisfied with the apartment after the viewing, you may then proceed with the booking.
*

*
Long-Stay Booking Terms:

*
To confirm and secure a 3-month or 6-month booking, the first month's rent, last month's rent, and refundable security deposit must be paid in advance. Once the payment is received, we will be able to reserve the unit and guarantee the agreed rate for the confirmed booking period.

Thank you, and we look forward to assisting you.
